Unstabilized dying: CON at the end of the next round and every round, failure is death; only First Aid can stabilize. Stabilized dying: CON each hour; failure loses the temporary HP and reverts to the round clock
0 HP plus Major Wound ticked is dying: record HP 0 and check the dying box

First Aid within one hour grants 1 HP; may be attempted once, later attempts are Pushed; two people may work together (either success); on a dying patient it only temporarily stabilizes (+1 temporary HP, followed by Medicine)
A single attack dealing more than maximum HP kills outright
The Major Wound marker is erased by an Extreme recovery roll, or any time current HP has recovered to half or more of maximum HP
On a Major Wound: tick the box, fall prone, make a CON roll to stay conscious; 0 HP while ticked means dying
A single attack dealing half or more of maximum HP is a Major Wound (rounded up)

computed_threshold.source_example: 15 hit points, damage of 8 or more is a major wound

nodes.name: Medicine takes at least one hour, works any time after damage, and raises difficulty to Hard when not performed the same day; success restores 1D3 in addition to First Aid; a dying character needs successful First Aid before Medicine can stabilize
Without a Major Wound ticked, recover 1 HP per day

While the Major Wound box is ticked, make a CON recovery roll at the end of each week: fail = no recovery, success = 1D3, Extreme = 2D3 and erase the marker; bonus die for complete rest in a comfortable environment; bonus die for effective medical care (caregiver Medicine roll first); penalty die for poor environment/insufficient rest or a caregiver Medicine fumble; a fumble creates a lasting injury/complication
No negative HP; 0 HP is unconscious; further damage ignored but a sincere kill attempt succeeds; regular damage cannot kill at 0 HP
